notes: Music and video now keep playing when you leave the app, with previous, next, shuffle and repeat buttons and the cover art in the notification. Rapid+ can open mp3, mp4, pictures and text files from other apps with its own player. Background tabs keep running and pages open at the right size. New in Settings: unload inactive tabs, hide your IP from WebRTC, and choose the time zone websites see.

desktop.notes: Every profile now opens in its own window, like Chrome. Pick another profile from your picture to open it separately, and the windows you had open come back when you start Rapid+. Your profiles, tabs, bookmarks and passwords stay as they are.
